remove: From morning till evening he works.
He works from morning to evening.
From morning to evening he works.
why: Three renderings of a different sentence entirely — «Он рабо́тает с утра́ до ве́чера», not «Он дожда́лся у́тра до́ма». They read as a block left behind when the Russian they were written for was replaced. Present since before the review; harmless while the word bank built its tiles from the primary alone, but assemblable — and so reliably offered as a correct answer — once the bank was widened to make curated alternates usable.
